caption: The drawing features a single teapot centered within a rectangular border. The teapot has a round, bulbous body rendered in charcoal gray tones, with detailed shading to suggest a metallic surface. The handle, constructed in a pronounced, sweeping curve, is colored a warm brown, imitating wood. The teapot has a tall, domed lid with a finial at the top, and a narrow, elongated spout that extends outward and curves upward. In the bottom right corner of the drawing, there is a small inset sketch showing a simplified, lined version of the same teapot, annotated with letters and arrows. The main drawing is surrounded by a pale tan background, and the artist's signature, "Charles Cullen," is located in the lower left outside the main border.
title: Pewter Teapot
